limitations: One screening sample per newly measured route; homepage local median has three earlier same-day samples.
Simulated mobile results are laboratory data, not real-user p75 or INP.
Local gzip and live Brotli/CDN environments differ; their scores cannot establish deployment gains.
No Search Console, CrUX or GA4 aggregate field data inspected. No accepted-advertising scenario measured.
Desktop results of 99 are earlier same-day samples for homepage and Perla II only.
TTFB values are individual workstation observations, including connection overhead, not global server benchmarks.
Lighthouse image savings are estimates; quality and text legibility require visual validation.
Full-scroll, all-slide, catalog, 360-tour and interaction sessions are not represented by the initial-load page totals.
